scope: Reproduced live ambiguous playlist entry IDs, independent occurrence selection/playback, safe per-row edits and recovery reservation session guard; P04/P19 remain Review

decision.Boris: Support independent local row identity, stable raw keys for unique entries and per-row edit availability; no full-list replacement.
decision.Nadia: Support; raised queued reservation account check, then reviewed final wiring without blocker.
decision.Elena: Reviewed per-row controls/selection and final conditional render adjustment without blocker; full screen-reader interaction remains separate.
decision.implementation: Valid unique IDs retain stable selection/mutation keys. Ambiguous/missing/invalid IDs receive compact [rawId,songId,index] selection keys. New entries snapshots clear fallback selections while retaining stable keys. Backend rereads IDs/bounds before reserving, and recovery queue/dispatch recheck captured session.

evidenceLimits: Live server returns the same PlaylistItemId for repeated songs. There is no verified safe per-occurrence edit route for those positions; they remain selectable/playable with Move/Remove disabled. P04 is not marked complete.
P19 adds the explicit missing/invalid/repeated-ID contract; native missing/invalid-ID and wider fault variants remain under Review despite service coverage.
External clients can change server state between preflight and write; no conditional-write/transaction API was observed.
A crash after a durable reservation but before HTTP may conservatively require review, as expected for pre-dispatch journaling.
Fourteen controlled cases use actual service/recovery coordinator and local HTTP, with atomicWrite and Electron path stand-ins; they verify ordering/guards, not OS atomic durability.

Live native uses actual current main/preload/renderer and real protected profile; provider keys null and external networking blocked. Hidden/muted execution does not establish audible quality or human usability.
cleanup: Every live test playlist was deleted with204, follow-up metadata404 and fresh-list absence. No existing playlist or music file was edited.
verificationCorrections: ESLint rejected synchronous state adjustment in an effect; replaced with React conditional render adjustment keyed to changed entries, without suppressing the rule.
Controlled queue fixture initially observed an expected rejected promise too late; attached its rejection handler immediately. Final14 cases pass.
